name: Mars transit
location: Deep space, between Earth and Mars
evacuation: None. Earth is months away, so the crew must treat every problem onboard.

healthFocus.title: Highest radiation of the mission
healthFocus.detail: Outside Earth's magnetic field there is no natural shield. During a solar storm, go to the storm shelter at once.

healthFocus.title: Bone and muscle loss
healthFocus.detail: Months of weightlessness before landing. Keep up resistance exercise so you can stand and work on Mars.

healthFocus.title: Isolation and long delays
healthFocus.detail: Messages to Earth take up to 22 minutes each way. Look after sleep, mood and team relations; use the support options early.

healthFocus.title: No quick way home
healthFocus.detail: Medical decisions are made onboard. Daily check-ins catch problems early, while they are still easy to treat.
